label: Recruiter / Intro
description: Initial process, role, or logistics conversation.

label: Hiring Manager
description: Role context, experience, scope, and mutual fit discussion.

label: System Design
description: Architecture, requirements, tradeoffs, and operations discussion.

label: ML Design
description: Machine-learning system framing, data, modeling, and serving discussion.

label: Behavioral
description: Past experience, judgment, collaboration, and reflection discussion.

label: Technical Discussion
description: High-level technical experience or domain conversation.

label: Take-home
description: Offline work; describe only format and permitted high-level context.

label: Presentation
description: Presentation or walkthrough of work that may be discussed publicly.

label: Team / Values
description: Team interaction, working preferences, or values conversation.

label: Other
description: A process stage not covered by the neutral taxonomy.
